proceduralPrograms.name: Foliage

parameters.label: Density
parameters.description: Leaf candidates per square world model unit; LOD and budget cap the work.

parameters.label: Leaf length
parameters.description: Length in local model units, with seeded size variation.

parameters.label: Leaf width
parameters.description: Maximum width in local model units.

parameters.label: Height above surface
parameters.description: Root height along the source normal; zero places leaves directly on the surface.

parameters.label: Edge spread
parameters.description: Random tangent-plane offset in local units, allowing leaves beyond the source boundary.

parameters.label: Tilt (degrees)
parameters.description: Leaf angle above the source plane, with seeded variation.

parameters.label: Curl
parameters.description: Tip curl relative to leaf length.

parameters.label: Wind strength
parameters.description: Animated tip motion relative to leaf length; zero pauses animation.

parameters.label: Color variation
parameters.description: Seeded variation in leaf brightness.

parameters.label: Leaf color
parameters.description: RGBA channels in the range zero to one.

parameters.label: Alternate color
parameters.description: RGBA channels in the range zero to one.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.description: Deterministic variation. Changing this reshuffles the result.

proceduralPrograms.name: Branching fractal

parameters.label: Form
parameters.description: Rule family for the GPU generator.

parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: Tree height in local model units.

parameters.label: Crown radius
parameters.description: Maximum crown radius.

parameters.label: Trunk radius
parameters.description: Trunk base radius.

parameters.label: Primary branches
parameters.description: Rendering detail; bounded by the instance budget.

parameters.label: Children per branch
parameters.description: Rendering detail; bounded by the instance budget.

parameters.label: Branching depth
parameters.description: Rendering detail; bounded by the instance budget.

parameters.label: Leaf budget
parameters.description: Rendering detail; bounded by the instance budget.

parameters.label: Leaf size
parameters.description: Leaf card length in local units.

parameters.label: Wind strength
parameters.description: Maximum sway as a fraction of height; zero pauses animation.

parameters.label: Growth
parameters.description: Continuous growth from an empty object to the configured branching depth.

parameters.label: Branch survival
parameters.description: Continuous seeded pruning; zero retains only the trunk. Descendants inherit parent survival.

parameters.label: Branch angle
parameters.description: Angle from the parent's tangent, in degrees.

parameters.label: Phyllotactic angle
parameters.description: Rotation between child slots, in degrees. Slot identity stays stable when counts change.

parameters.label: Attachment
parameters.description: Attachment position along the parent curve; primary branches are distributed along the trunk.

parameters.label: Length ratio
parameters.description: Child length relative to its parent, before family and random variation.

parameters.label: Radius ratio
parameters.description: Child radius relative to the parent radius at its attachment.

parameters.label: Curvature
parameters.description: Quadratic branch curvature; child frames follow the curved parent tangent.

parameters.label: Tropism
parameters.description: Positive bends toward local up; negative bends down. Roots invert their local up.

parameters.label: Variation
parameters.description: Deterministic variation of lengths, angles and attachments.

parameters.label: Branch LOD
parameters.description: Fade subpixel branch hierarchies in the viewport. Zero disables branch LOD; bake captures full detail.

parameters.label: Bark
parameters.description: RGBA channels in the range zero to one.

parameters.label: Leaves
parameters.description: RGBA channels in the range zero to one.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.description: Deterministic variation. Changing this reshuffles the result.

branchingLimits.hook: branchingRule(inout BranchRule rule,int level,int child,uvec2 path,uint key)
branchingLimits.ruleType: struct BranchRule { float attach; float angle; float azimuth; float lengthScale; float radiusScale; float bend; float tropism; float activation; vec3 parentStart; vec3 parentControl; vec3 parentEnd; vec3 parentFrame; float parentRadius; };
branchingLimits.pathEncoding: root=1; append four-bit child+1 slots; x=low32, y=high32

ruleFields.angle: Deflection from parent tangent in radians, clamped 0..pi
ruleFields.azimuth: Rotation around parent tangent in radians
ruleFields.activation: Continuous child survival, clamped 0..1; inherited by descendants
ruleFields.parentStart: vec3; read-only local parent curve start; writes ignored
ruleFields.parentControl: vec3; read-only local quadratic control point; writes ignored
ruleFields.parentEnd: vec3; read-only local parent curve end; writes ignored
ruleFields.parentFrame: vec3; read-only transported frame reference; writes ignored
ruleFields.parentRadius: float; read-only parent base radius; writes ignored
